# IndieFindr
Discover indie games similar to games you already enjoy.

- Game pages: https://www.indiefindr.gg/games/{Steam app ID}
- Search: https://www.indiefindr.gg/api/games/search?q={title}

Any Steam game may have a page. Recommendations contain only indie games,
selected from stored editorial-era lists or an offline ranking model.
No recommendations are generated during a page request.
